title: AFTER: Mitigating the Object Hallucination of LVLM via Adaptive Factual-Guided Activation Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating object hallucination across discriminative and generative tasks using metrics like Accuracy and F1-score on the POPE and MME benchmarks, and CHAIR/Hal metrics on the AMBER benchmark, to measure the extent to which models prioritize textual priors over external visual evidence.
